title: Input caret is the terminal's default cursor colour, not amber
observed: The input box cursor renders as the terminal's default light-grey block.
expected: Design sets caret-color #e9a64b (amber) on the input; kiln can request it via the cursor colour (OSC 12) while running and restore it on exit.

fix.note: Caret is amber in iTerm2 (light shot shows the amber block); the renderer resets the cursor colour on exit (cursed_renderer close).
